english.title: Transport specimen of species listed in Annex B to Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97 for sale
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) transported for sale a specimen of a species listed in Annex B to Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97, namely **(..SPECIFY SPECIES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 1 of Schedule 1 to the Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations 2018.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 4 of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations 2018 provides defences to this offence.
(ii) The management authority shall have discretion to sell any specimen of the species listed in Annex B that they have confiscated under Article 8.6 of Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97, provided that it is not thus returned directly to the person or entity from whom it was confiscated or who was party to the offence. Such specimens may then be treated for all purposes as if they had been legally acquired. In these circumstances the offence will not apply (see Article 8.6 of Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97).
(iii) Where it can be proved to the satisfaction of the management authority that such specimens were acquired and, if they originated outside Great Britain, were introduced into it, in accordance with the legislation in force for the conservation of wild fauna and flora then the offence will not be committed (see Article 8.5 of Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97).

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum imprisonment of 6 months and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum imprisonment of 5 years and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
